availability_audit: Chronology: every source map precedes Jagged Pass in book play order (Route 101-104, 111, 116, 117, Petalburg Woods, Granite Cave, Rusturf Tunnel, Seaspray Cave, Mauville Game Corner). Togepi Route102 land g14 -> friendship Togetic -> Shiny Stone Togekiss g24. Squirtle Mauville Game Corner 500 coins g30 -> Wartortle -> Blastoise g36; Blastoisinite stone-window=14, base-window=36, Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly. Marill Petalburg City old_rod g14 -> Azumarill g20. Swinub Seaspray_Cave_B1F land g14 -> Piloswine -> Mamoswine known-move g36. Abra GraniteCave_1F g20 -> Kadabra -> Alakazam Linking Cord g20. Drilbur RusturfTunnel land g20 -> Excadrill level g36. No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species; single Mega slot. Ordinary held items from the free Center held-item catalogue. Cap-42 re-check for this rerun: the window moved 36 -> 42 (FLAG_BADGE04_GET), which is the window the plan targets ('Medium cap40 levels' = 42 + offset - 2). No member was added or changed, so every source above is still a gate<=36 map that precedes Lavaridge in book play order (C02-C22); nothing depends on the Heat Badge, Strength, Surf or any post-Lavaridge area. Gate-42 species that ARE chronology-legal here were considered and deliberately not used: Skarmory (Route113, C21 ash route), Turtonator (JaggedPass, C22/C23) and Drampa (MeteorFalls_1F_1R, C22). The Meteor Falls Surf-gated rooms (1F_2R, B1F_1R, B1F_2R - Altaria, Swablu, Lapras, Salamence, Goodra, Dragonite, Noivern) are NOT legal here: Surf arrives at C27, four chapters after this Gym. Attempt 2 changes no species relative to attempt 1 except dropping Mega Blastoise entirely, so the audit above still covers every member. No Mega is used at all in attempt 2.
plan: Attempt 1 lost 6-4 and Victreebel was NOT the problem this time - the -1 from the first run plus Alakazam's Psychic removed it on turn 2. The problem was Choice Specs Simisear: at -6 Sp.Atk, under sun, with a Prankster Helping Hand from Volbeat, its Overheat still one-shot a full-HP Thick Fat Mamoswine (157) and later took 125 off Excadrill. Two further mistakes were mine: I let Volbeat live for four turns feeding Helping Hand and Struggle Bug, and I sent Mega Blastoise into a board holding Scovillain's Energy Ball and Mega Charizard X's Thunder Punch, both 2x into Water. Attempt 2 fixes all three. Volbeat dies on turn 1 to a doubled Rock Slide plus Psychic (Rock is 2x into Bug), which removes Helping Hand from the fight before Simisear ever appears. Excadrill becomes the win condition rather than a Mega: Ground is 2x into five of Gerald's six (Victreebel via Poison, Simisear, Scovillain, Pyroar and Mega Charizard X, which is Fire/Dragon and not Flying), and Mold Breaker ignores Flash Fire-style interference. Togekiss brings Tailwind instead of just redirecting, because Excadrill at 88 base Speed loses to Chlorophyll Victreebel, Simisear and Pyroar without it and wins against all of them with it. Garganacl replaces Mega Blastoise as the body that actually survives this room: Rock takes Fire at 0.5 and Purifying Salt makes it immune to every status the room could still land on an ungrounded target. No Water-typed body is brought at all, since Energy Ball and Thunder Punch are both 2x into Water and the sun halves Water attacks anyway.
